verdict.rationale: Crossplane documents that it exposes declarative, machine-readable Kubernetes APIs that humans, automation and AI agents can act on, and that these APIs work with standard Kubernetes tooling, so the product can be driven programmatically. However, the pack contains no API reference documentation, endpoint or schema docs, or hands-on evidence of agents driving it, so coverage of the story is only partial. missing for 10: published API reference/schema documentation, documented authentication and access patterns for programmatic clients, independent or hands-on corroboration of AI/automation clients driving the API

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Expose declarative APIs that humans, automation, and AI systems can safely act on
declarative APIs that make intent explicit, auditable, and and machine-readable
enable consumers, whether human users, automated workflows, or AI agents, to self-service
It's built on Kubernetes, so it works with all the Kubernetes tools you already use.
a highly configurable frontend that puts you in control of the schema of the declarative API it offers.
